items.title: Cathie Wood and 10 Other Big Funds Sold Caterpillar Last Quarter, While 13 Bought. Who’s Right?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOf the 460 big funds that have filed 13Fs for the third quarter, 13 bought Caterpillar and 11 sold, Cathie Wood’s ARK Invest among the sellers. The sellers moved far more money: Alphinity Investment Management’s cut was worth about $181 million, against about $21 million for the biggest buy.

items.title: Deere (DE) Acquires An AI Crop Monitoring Startup
items.summary: John Deere (NYSE:DE) has acquired Orchard Robotics, an AI crop monitoring startup focused on real time fruit and crop analysis. The Orchard Robotics technology uses computer vision and machine learning to track crop conditions directly from farm equipment in the field. Deere plans to integrate Orchard Robotics tools into its precision agriculture platform so farmers can act on detailed crop level data. The acquisition of Orchard Robotics sits against wider themes our research has identified...

items.title: Deere (DE) Nears Earnings, Is It A Bargain Or Fully Priced?
items.summary: Deere (DE) heads into its fourth quarter fiscal 2026 report on November 25, with investor attention focused on how weak farmer spending and low commodity prices have filtered through to recent results. The recent pullback in Deere’s share price tells the story. The stock is down 2.50% over the last day and 9.55% over the past week, and has eased 4.29% across 30 days. Yet the year to date share price return of 30.52% and 1 year total shareholder return of 26.47% still point to a strong run...

items.title: Caterpillar Sinks 11% in a Week to a New 52-Week Low. Is the Selling Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCaterpillar fell 11% in the past week to a new 52-week low, about half its June high, as the AI-infrastructure sell-off also hit Vertiv and Bloom Energy. Caterpillar had no bad news of its own, and management told a Bernstein event it sees a favorable 2027.

items.title: Caterpillar’s 35% 3-Month Downturn: This Sell-Side Firm Predicts 90% Returns From Here With Another Close Behind
items.summary: Caterpillar posted record backlog and still lost a third of its value in three months while Deere and CNH held firm. Two firms say the damage is overdone, but one number in January could prove them wrong.

items.title: Deere Set to Report Q4 Earnings: What to Expect From the Stock?
items.summary: DE's Q4 earnings outlook reflects weak farmer spending and lower agricultural demand, while favorable pricing and Construction & Forestry growth offer support.

items.title: 2 Farm ETFs Own What Every Grocery Store Depends On
items.summary: Two funds beat the S&P 500 this past year, yet both lagged it badly over five. One spreads bets across the food chain while the other leans on a single tractor maker. Which approach fits your portfolio?
